Next.js addresses this delay by [prefetching](#prefetching) routes the user is likely to visit and performing [client-side transitions](#client-side-transitions). > **Good to know**: HTML is also generated for the initial visit. ### Prefetching Prefetching is the process of loading a route in the background before the user navigates to it.
